description: Stage 7: the router learns from the receipts on the chain (choice C): c and l and an accuracy correction per (group, model) come from the visible receipts, the forests still retrain on the router's own answers. Experiment 1: one router on the live data, learning from the chain. Experiment 2: 5 routers on LLMRouterBench, each alone (own receipts) or sharing (everyone's receipts). Experiment 3: a lying router (audits remove it) and a secret model swap, on the live data. Learning is simulated in memory; one run per experiment is repeated on the real chain.

llmrouterbench.prices_note: Official prices in USD per million input / output tokens, from LLMRouterBench Table 8; Claude Sonnet 4 from Anthropic's price list. Only stored with the model registration.

attacks.note: Experiment 3 on the live data, the 5 routers sharing. Attack 6 (Fevzi's E4): the liar reports Haiku right and Opus wrong in its receipts and also makes up such receipts for every question it handles; audits re-check 10% and remove a router after 3 failures. Attack 7 (Fevzi's E3): from 25% of the stream on, Sol returns Terra's answers (heavily used model) and, separately, Opus returns Haiku's.
